verdict.rationale: Graphite documents an in-PR conversational AI. Graphite Chat on the PR review page answers questions, explains changes, gives context on highlighted lines, and helps implement reviewer feedback. It also takes commands such as suggesting and applying fixes, diagnosing failing CI, or having the Agent commit changes. However, the evidence shows this as a separate chat or agent side panel, not as replying directly to Graphite Agent's review comments in the PR thread. missing for 10: documented ability to reply to the AI reviewer's inline comments in-thread and get contextual responses there, independent or hands-on corroboration of conversational quality.
